verdict.rationale: The Devin MCP docs say its tools let you explore and query documentation for any GitHub repository, public or private with authentication. Separately, repository indexing powers DeepWiki and Ask Devin, the generated-documentation and Q&A features. Missing for 10: support for non-GitHub hosts (evidence names only GitHub), detail on how the generated docs are produced and queried beyond one-line mentions, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
